def am_sequence(x, iterations):
    x_list = [x]
    current_x = x
    for _ in range(iterations):
        next_x = (current_x + 1/current_x) / 2
        x_list.append(next_x)
        current_x = next_x
    return x_list

def hm_sequence(x, iterations):
    x_list = [x]
    current_x = x
    for _ in range(iterations):
        next_x = 2 / (current_x + 1/current_x)
        x_list.append(next_x)
        current_x = next_x
    return x_list
